review_description: A lot of people selling sysytems but putting other systems/suppliers down. I do not believe in under handed sales pitch. Sell your system using its assets not what other products/suppliers do not offer.  I saw a few 'second hand car salesman' types. Saw 6 different suppliers.
So good was the service, all who helped, the girls in Cairns, sales representative, and the installers, were excellent and pleasant in all ways .
Main trouble is getting Energex to change meter as the one we have is not suitable for solar, am still waiting after 4 weeks since installation.

The system has been installed for two weeks now, and considering the small amount of Sun we have had in that time we are having some great results.On monday morning at 0715hrs our meter reading was 37830 when I checked just now Friday 1349hrs it was on 37835, and it's still raining.We are very happy with our purchase.Many thanks for your help!
